resources.string: Record what you find while using Mokya IME in real apps. Results are kept on the phone until you reset them. With the diagnostics log on, the keyboard records its events (keys, touches, layout; never the text, and nothing at all in password or incognito fields) so a report can show what happened. Share or save the report when you are done; the last one is also kept for adb:\nadb shell run-as io.github.tengigabytes.mokyaime cat files/fieldtest/report.md
The report could not be saved.
